label: This-designated necessity versus the…: The source’s minor asserts that a per-se necessary being is…
term: this-designated necessity versus the common notion of necessity
definition: The source’s minor asserts that a per-se necessary being is necessary precisely as this designated individual, because otherwise its designation/actual distinct being would depend on another. This concerns the candidate’s own individuated necessity, distinct from a shared generic necessity predicate.
note: No independent principle says every non-self-necessary designation depends on an external cause, or that each candidate’s own necessity instance is the same numerical item. The resulting incommunicability/uniqueness transfer and ordinary-ground dictionary remain open.
